item.title: Vibe 1.17
item.description: * Added mouse/trackpad scrolling and up/down keys to change the volume (when enabled) * Added Copy and Paste for colors and fonts in the theme editor's right-click menu * Added each theme's swatch to the View > Theme menu * Changed MP3, FLAC, WAV, AIFF and Ogg Vorbis files to always play with Vibe's own decoders * Moved the volume slider appearance and behavior settings from themes to Settings > Appearance * Improved playback of Ogg Vorbis files that also carry video or a Skeleton stream * Fixed 320 kbps MP3s opening slowly

item.title: Vibe 1.17-beta1
item.description: * Added mouse/trackpad scrolling and up/down keys to change the volume (when enabled) * Added Copy and Paste for colors and fonts in the theme editor's right-click menu * Moved the volume slider appearance and behavior settings from themes to Settings > Appearance * Fixed 320 kbps MP3s opening slowly

item.title: Vibe 1.16
item.description: * New: Open Location… (⌘L) plays a web link, or a Dropbox, Google Drive, or iCloud Drive share link * New: the Spectrum waveform style, with By section coloring so each part of a song keeps one color * New: the RGB, Dark Core, Kinda Blue, and Sectioned themes, and Dark Core's app icon, contributed by JohnnyFireOne * New: Move to Trash (⌘⌫) deletes the selected or playing song's file, with Undo * New: Add to Playlist… (⇧⌘O), Show in Finder (⇧⌘R), and a Window menu with Minimize, Window Width, Always on Top, and Lock Window Position * New: a Buffering… status while a song waits for a slow network share or download * New: theme colors for the playing and selected rows' text and the playing row's equalizer bars, and Clear, Window, Symbol, and Custom default artwork * New: click the pitch panel's header to switch its range between 8% and 16% * New: free-format MP3 playback * New: the vibe theme track, which loads on launch until you play or open something * Changed: the menus follow macOS conventions, with Edit > Copy, a Repeat submenu, and Skip Back and Skip Forward submenus that show each distance in bars or seconds * Changed: the waveform styles are renamed: Basic is now Bars, Cupertino Basic is now Progress, and the four Detailed styles are one with a type setting * Changed: Previous on the first song restarts it * Changed: the volume slider appears near the pointer, with a theme setting for when it shows * Changed: the playhead line is slightly see-through, and the playing row's equalizer bars are black in light mode * Changed: the Cupertino theme darkens only the cover art behind the playback buttons, with a lighter gradient * Improved: the pitch fader sounds better, with a custom repitch engine and smooth changes * Improved: bit-perfect output uses the device's widest bit depth, for cleaner volume changes and gapless playback between 16 and 24-bit songs * Improved: network share playback: a dropped connection pauses with "Connection lost", a slow server no longer stalls track changes, and hi-res songs play smoothly * Improved: MP3, FLAC, WAV, and AIFF songs open faster * Improved: the Settings window has clearer names, reasons under disabled rows, a confirmation before restoring defaults, and a jump bar in the theme editor * Fixed: gapless playback of mono and MPEG-2 MP3s * Fixed: Opus files whose header sets a volume played at the wrong level * Fixed: Ogg Vorbis songs lost their first 3 ms * Fixed: a corrupt CAF file could stall the metadata scan * Fixed: the waveform's hover line got lost over the played part * Fixed: on macOS 27, theme changes cleared the playlist selection, and memory grew on every playlist open and theme change

item.title: Vibe 1.16-beta12
item.description: * Added By section coloring to the Spectrum waveform, so each part of a song keeps one color * Added the Sectioned theme * Added playback of free-format MP3s * Changed the default playhead line to be slightly see-through * Improved how quickly MP3, FLAC, WAV and AIFF songs open * Improved bit-perfect output to use the device's widest bit depth: cleaner volume changes, and gapless between 16 and 24-bit songs * Fixed gapless playback of mono and MPEG-2 MP3s * Fixed Opus files whose header sets a volume playing at the wrong level * Fixed Ogg Vorbis songs losing their first 3 ms * Fixed memory growth on every playlist open and theme change on macOS 27

item.title: Vibe 1.16-beta11
item.description: * Changed the skip items into Skip Back and Skip Forward submenus * Fixed a corrupt CAF file stalling the metadata scan

item.title: Vibe 1.16-beta10
item.description: * New: a theme color for the playing row's equalizer bars * Changed the playing row's equalizer bars to black in light mode

item.title: Vibe 1.16-beta9
item.description: * New: separate theme colors for the row number and the duration of the playing row and selected rows

item.title: Vibe 1.16-beta8
item.description: * New: the Kinda Blue theme * New: a Default artwork choice for every theme: Artwork, Clear, Window, or a custom color * New: a Window menu with Minimize (⌘M), Window Width, Always on Top, and Lock Window Position * New: Show in Finder (⇧⌘R) and Play in the menus * New: click PITCH at the top of the pitch panel to switch the range between 8% and 16% * Changed: the menus follow the macOS conventions, with Edit > Copy, Open Location… (⌘L), and a Repeat submenu * Changed: the skip items show their distance in bars or seconds * Changed: Move to Trash (⌘⌫) also trashes the playing song while the playlist is hidden * Changed: Dark Wolf is now Dark Core, with the row colors its author chose * Changed: the theme track stays in the playlist until you play or open something * Changed: the Cupertino theme darkens only cover art behind the playback buttons * Improved: the Settings window, with clearer names, reasons under disabled rows, a confirmation before restoring defaults, and a jump bar in the theme editor

item.title: Vibe 1.16-beta7
item.description: * New: separate theme colors for the title and the artist of the playing row and selected rows

item.title: Vibe 1.16-beta6
item.description: * New: Buffering… shows while a song waits for a slow network share or download * New: theme colors for the text of the playing row and selected rows * Changed: Vibe checks for updates once a day instead of once a week * Changed: update checks count active installs, with no identifier and no IP address * Improved: hi-res songs play more smoothly from a slow network share * Fixed: the waveform's hover line getting lost over the played part * Fixed: theme changes clearing the playlist selection on macOS 27

item.title: Vibe 1.16-beta5
item.description: * New: the Spectrum waveform style colors each bar by its mix of bass, mids, and highs * New: the RGB theme, which uses the Spectrum style * New: Add to Playlist… (⇧⌘O) in the File menu * New: Move to Trash (⌘⌫) deletes a song's file from the playlist, with Undo * New: Open URL… plays iCloud Drive share links * New: the Dark Wolf theme changes the app icon * Changed: Basic is now Bars, and Cupertino Basic is now Progress * Changed: the four Detailed styles are now one style with a Type setting * Changed: Previous on the first song restarts it * Improved: a slow network share no longer stalls track changes * Fixed: the resize cursor sometimes vanishing at the window's right edge

item.title: Vibe 1.16-beta4
item.description: * Changed: this beta tests automatic updates; nothing else changed

item.title: Vibe 1.16-beta3
item.description: * New: Open URL… (⌘U) plays an audio file from a web address, including Dropbox and Google Drive share links * New: drop a web link on the player to play it * New: automatic updates, and Check for Updates in the Vibe menu * New: Cut and Paste in the Edit menu * Improved: the pitch fader sounds cleaner and glides instead of stepping * Fixed: a network share that stops answering now pauses with "Connection lost" instead of going silent
